correctness.rationale: Solve the two-step EMA recurrence: m_(2n)=(beta A-B)/(1+beta)*(1-beta^(2n)), m_(2n-1)=(A-beta B)/(1+beta)-(beta A-B)*beta^(2n-1)/(1+beta). These give exact sign thresholds beta<=r<1/beta for all-step agreement, zero even EMA at r=1/beta, alternating odd agreement/even disagreement for r>1/beta, and a unique transient odd sign crossing for r<beta with first strictly negative odd index 2N-1, N=floor((1+log((beta-r)/(1-beta*r))/log beta)/2)+1. Direct rational-arithmetic recurrence checked 2520 parameter/time cases and separately exact-zero odd boundaries; beta=0.9 window [0.9,10/9) holds. The base PowerSign/AddSign multipliers follow by source substitution.
residual_risks: The statement concerns a scalar coordinate with prescribed input and base rules; sign(0)=0 and bias correction positive. The transient logarithmic formula has strict inequality at exact zero crossings.
